facts.fact: Urbanism minister Mory Condé said on 3 October 2024 that a national addressing programme is 100% done in Kaloum commune and will extend to Dixinn, Matam, the other Conakry communes, Coyah, Dubréka and regional and prefecture towns.
Minister Mory Condé said a geolocation application for the addresses is already available, tested and usable without an internet connection, to be released to the public.
